name: Rosewash lane house
storeys: Two storeys plus a roof loft
role: Ordinary side streets and gaps between taller neighbours
design: A COMPACT TWO-STOREY lane home with a small roof loft, approximately 5.5 m frontage by 6 m deep. Warm pale SALMON/ROSE limewashed upper walls over a pale stone ground floor, oak corner posts and a modest supported upper-floor jetty. A simple asymmetrical gabled CLAY-TILE roof with one off-centre little shed dormer and a brick chimney at its left-rear edge. A sage-green front door at one side of the ground facade, one domestic ground window and two upper windows with partly open shutters. The side has just one narrow stair window, not another shopfront. Rear includes a shallow one-storey pantry lean-to with a sloping tiled roof, a practical kitchen door, stacked firewood and a few pots close to the wall. This is a believable small inhabited family house, with distinct rose plaster and a simple slightly uneven roof silhouette, no dramatic balcony or turret.
